task.title: P6-176: Fix three shape-only unit tests and remove one dead alias
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-176. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Three unit tests that assert shape rather than substance, plus one dead alias** (was `P6-009c` + `P6-024i` + `P6-030h` + `P6-055l`): `toaster_offset`'s test asserts only string *shape* (`shell.rs:614-642`), so it cannot catch a wrong magnitude, and the e2e that could only ever exercises a one-card tray pill; `fn named(…)` is a verbatim alias for `fn row(…)` in `tree_manage.rs:1134-1136`'s test module, dead indirection; `Undo last move`'s **recording** is verified end-to-end only on the removal path, so a dropped `record` call on the add / batch-move / pull sites would not fail the suite; and `bench/count_stepper.rs:67` reads "1 copies" while the product path pluralizes correctly.
